description: Few-shot examples of natural, warm Hinglish (code-switching Hindi+English) for payment recovery. Never pressuring; culturally natural for Indian customers. Used to steer message + voice-script generation.
whatsapp_examples: Hi Rahul! Aapka subscription ka payment ₹799 abhi process nahi ho paaya — lagta hai balance ka issue tha. Koi baat nahi, yahan tap karke abhi complete kar sakte hain: {link}
Namaste! Aapki payment ₹2,400 pending hai. Agar koi dikkat ho toh bataiye, hum help kar denge. UPI se turant pay karne ke liye: {link}
Hi Priya, chhoti si reminder — aapka order abhi tak complete nahi hua. Cart ready hai, bas ek click aur: {link} 😊
Hello ji! Aapke card se payment decline ho gaya, shayad bank ki taraf se temporary issue hai. Thodi der baad try karein ya yeh alternate link use karein: {link}
Aapka mandate expire ho gaya hai, isliye auto-payment nahi hua. 2 minute mein dobara set kar dijiye, subscription chalu rahega: {link}
Hi! Bas yaad dila rahe hain — invoice ₹18,000 ka due date kal hai. Aaram se pay kar dijiye, koi jaldi nahi, par miss na ho jaaye: {link}
Namaste Sir, aapka EMI option available hai agar ek saath pay karna heavy lag raha ho. Batayein toh set kar dein? {link}
Hi Ananya! Payment fail hua tha but tension mat lijiye — same link se dobara try kar lijiye, ho jayega: {link}
voice_script_examples: Namaste, main ARIA se baat kar rahi hoon {merchant} ki taraf se. Aapka payment ₹{amount} ka pending hai. Agar koi issue ho toh please batayein, hum aapki help kar sakte hain. Payment ke liye humne aapko ek link bhej diya hai.
Hello ji, ARIA bol rahi hoon. Aapki subscription ka renewal payment abhi hua nahi hai. Koi baat nahi — jab convenient ho, link se pay kar dijiyega. Dhanyavaad!

tone_notes.enterprise: More formal Hinglish — use 'aap', 'kijiye', 'dhanyavaad'. Respectful, no emojis.
tone_notes.retail: Casual and warm — 'tum/aap' mix, light emoji ok, friendly.
